The hybrid profile (tls13-hybrid-x25519-mlkem768, requiring kem:x25519mlkem768) yields the largest ready-endpoint batch: peer-01, peer-02, peer-04, and peer-06 all have readiness 'known' and advertise x25519mlkem768. peer-03 also qualifies technically but is excluded per engineering notes (scheduled decommission next week). peer-05 only advertises classical kem:x25519 and cannot use any PQC-capable profile, so it is left on its current setup for now (no unresolved readiness issue - it simply lacks capability). This meets the policy's hybrid-pqc security floor.
